name: Sharek Me
author: Mokhtar Bensaid

sections.description:
Sharek Me – Social Media Sharing Plugin

  • Sharek Me is a powerful WordPress plugin designed to enhance user engagement by allowing seamless social media sharing of your posts and pages. This plugin offers an easy-to-use, customizable interface for displaying sharing buttons across various social platforms: Facebook, Twitter(X), LinkedIn, Pinterest, WhatsApp, Telegram, Reddit, Facebook Messenger, Viber, Flipboard, and you can also copy the link.

  • With flexible settings, you can control which social networks are displayed, adjust button styles and placement, and choose from various design options to match your site’s branding. Whether you prefer simple, clean buttons or a dynamic sharing experience with animations, Sharek Me provides the tools to enhance your content’s reach.

  • Ideal for bloggers, marketers, and businesses looking to improve their social media presence, Sharek Me makes sharing content as easy as a click, all while keeping your site looking sleek and

  • It offers shortcode [sharek_me] to the plugin, allowing users to place the sharing buttons anywhere on the website—inside posts, pages, widgets, or even custom templates.

Translations

  • Arabic

External Services

This plugin allows users to share posts and pages via various social media platforms. To achieve this functionality, the plugin constructs sharing URLs that redirect users to third-party services.

Services Used:

This plugin connects to the following external services:

  • Facebook: Used for sharing posts. Privacy Policy
  • X (Twitter): Used for tweeting shared content. Privacy Policy
  • Pinterest: Used for pinning shared content. Privacy Policy
  • LinkedIn: Used for sharing posts on LinkedIn. Privacy Policy
  • WhatsApp: Used for sharing via WhatsApp. Privacy Policy
  • Telegram: Used for sharing via Telegram. Privacy Policy
  • Reddit: Used for submitting shared content. Privacy Policy
  • Messenger: Used for sharing via Facebook Messenger. Privacy Policy
  • Viber: Used for forwarding shared content. Privacy Policy
  • Flipboard: Used for sharing on Flipboard. Privacy Policy

Data Shared:

  • The plugin does not collect, store, or transmit any user data to external servers.
  • The plugin generates a shareable link that contains the post/page URL.
  • When users click a share button, they are redirected to the respective service, where they can decide to share the content.

This plugin does not directly communicate with these external services. It simply constructs URLs that users manually click to share content.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the sharek-me folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to “Sharek Me” in the admin menu to configure settings.
sections.faq:
What is Sharek Me?

Sharek Me is a WordPress plugin that adds social media sharing buttons to your posts and pages.

Which social platforms are supported?

It supports Facebook, Twitter(X), LinkedIn, Pinterest, WhatsApp, Telegram, Reddit, Facebook Messenger, Viber, Flipboard, Copy link

Can I customize the button design?

Yes, you can customize the design, colors, animations, order, and placement of the buttons.

How do I enable or disable platforms?

You can enable or disable platforms through the plugin’s “General Settings” page.

Can I use it with any WordPress theme?

Yes, it works with any WordPress theme.

Does it slow down my site?

No, Sharek Me is lightweight and optimized for performance.

Is there a free version?

Yes, Sharek Me is fully free with all features.
